description: This source file defines an internal class ProbeRequestMonitor that monitors incoming cluster health probe requests within the Orleans Runtime Messaging namespace. It contains mechanisms to track when a probe request was last received and measure the elapsed time since then.

classes.name: ProbeRequestMonitor
classes.description: Monitors incoming health probe requests in an Orleans cluster, providing timing information for the most recent request.

methods.name: OnReceivedProbeRequest
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch to start timing from the moment a health probe request is received.

methods.name: ElapsedSinceLastProbeRequest
methods.description: Returns the time elapsed since the last received probe request; null if no request has been received since the stopwatch was started.
